hypothesis: A guided Milan cohort will produce usable repeat route feedback
success_metric: Activation plus repeat use plus valid feedback
stop_condition: Stop for unresolved reliability issue or fewer than 5 eligible participants
learning_outcome: Whether a mode community has recurring need
readiness_gate: Stable mode routing and consented measurement

hypothesis: A useful Milan pavé page will activate problem-intent visitors
stop_condition: Stop if page cannot provide verified local value
learning_outcome: Whether search intent maps to product use
readiness_gate: Indexable evidence page and coverage gate

hypothesis: A transparent founder origin video will drive qualified visits
content_or_offer: Founder story with current beta proof
stop_condition: Stop after three assets with no product-linked action
learning_outcome: Whether founder narrative converts beyond views

hypothesis: Guided beginner issues will increase completed first contributions
stop_condition: Stop if review backlog exceeds 14 days

hypothesis: A route-comparison short will outperform generic product content
stop_condition: Stop after three variants below baseline activation
readiness_gate: Safe footage and working landing page

hypothesis: A small university clinic will produce reproducible product learning
success_metric: Accepted bugs tests or method improvements
stop_condition: Cancel without facilitator or privacy protocol
learning_outcome: Whether structured academic participation is useful

hypothesis: Personalised evidence pitches will earn accurate coverage
content_or_offer: Five tailored pitches and factual kit
success_metric: Qualified replies demos or accurate coverage
stop_condition: Stop after two unanswered messages per target
learning_outcome: Which editorial angle has earned-media fit
readiness_gate: Working demo and verified founder bio

hypothesis: A creator evidence pitch can reach qualified mobility testers
stop_condition: Stop if fee exceeds cap or editorial independence is restricted
learning_outcome: Whether creator audience matches product use
readiness_gate: Organic evidence plus disclosure and rights review

hypothesis: A research-only future-region list will reveal problem interest outside Milan
content_or_offer: No-coverage research page with interview opt-in
stop_condition: Stop if visitors mistake it for supported coverage
learning_outcome: Which regions and hazards merit validation
readiness_gate: Clear no-coverage copy and separate consent

hypothesis: A moderated mapping session will produce verified corrections
stop_condition: Cancel if backlog or evidence rights are unresolved
readiness_gate: Data owner moderation capacity and safety protocol

hypothesis: A segmented partner explainer will generate qualified B2B discovery
stop_condition: Stop if product evidence is not relevant to target
learning_outcome: Which hosted capability may create B2B value

hypothesis: Small paid amplification of the best organic asset will scale retained users
stop_condition: Stop at approved cost cap or weaker retention than organic
readiness_gate: Stable product funnel and retained organic cohort

hypothesis: A separate crowdfunding-interest sequence will qualify supporters
stop_condition: Stop without legal review or credible funded milestone
learning_outcome: Whether community interest supports future campaign diligence
